name: Judah The Tribe Of
overview: The tribe of Judah, descended from Jacob's fourth son, is depicted in Scripture as a powerful and honored tribe, praised by their brethren and symbolized as a lion, demonstrating strength and leadership (Genesis 49:8-9). The promise that the sceptre would not depart from Judah until Shiloh comes highlights the tribe’s central role in God's redemptive plan, pointing forward to Christ as the ultimate King and Lawgiver (Genesis 49:10). Their prominence is further emphasized by their early offerings and leadership roles within Israel (Numbers 7:12), establishing Judah as the tribe appointed to furnish kings and lead God's people.
